"""Targeted behavior checks run through the real main.py subprocess."""
import json
import subprocess
import sys

MAIN = "/workspace/submission/main.py"

def run(raw: bytes):
    r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-B", "-u", MAIN], input=raw,
                       capture_output=True, cwd="/workspace/tmp")
    assert r.returncode == 0, ("exit", r.returncode, r.stderr[:500])
    out = r.stdout
    assert out.endswith(b"\n")
    return json.loads(out)

def eq(a, b, label):
    if a != b:
        print("FAIL", label)
        print("  got     ", json.dumps(a))
        print("  expected", json.dumps(b))
        return False
    print("PASS", label)
    return True

INVALID = {"error": "invalid_json"}
ok = True

# ---- JSON layer strictness
ok &= eq(run(b""), INVALID, "empty input")
ok &= eq(run(b"   \n "), INVALID, "whitespace only")
ok &= eq(b"\xef\xbb\xbf" + b'{"streams":[]}', b"\xef\xbb\xbf" + b'{"streams":[]}', "sanity")
ok &= eq(run(b"\xef\xbb\xbf{\"streams\":[]}"), INVALID, "BOM rejected")
ok &= eq(run(b'{"streams":[],"streams":[]}'), INVALID, "duplicate top key")
ok &= eq(run(b'{"streams":[{"a":1,"a":2}]}'), INVALID, "duplicate nested key")
ok &= eq(run(b'{"streams":[1,]}'), INVALID, "trailing comma")
ok &= eq(run(b'{"streams":[]} garbage'), INVALID, "trailing garbage")
ok &= eq(run(b'{"streams":'), INVALID, "unterminated")
ok &= eq(run(b'{"streams":[NaN]}'), INVALID, "NaN constant")
ok &= eq(run(b'{"streams":[Infinity]}'), INVALID, "Infinity constant")
ok &= eq(run(b'{"streams":[-Infinity]}'), INVALID, "-Infinity constant")
ok &= eq(run(b'\xff\xfe{"streams":[]}'), INVALID, "invalid UTF-8")
ok &= eq(run(b'{"streams":[1e400]}'), INVALID, "nonfinite literal")
ok &= eq(run(b'{"streams":' + b'['*200 + b']'*200 + b'}'), {"streams": [None]*0} if False else run(b'{"streams":' + b'['*200 + b']'*200 + b'}'), "deep nesting valid parse (no crash)")
ok &= eq(run(b'{"streams":[' + b'['*2000 + b']'*2000 + b']}'), INVALID, "extreme nesting -> invalid_json")
ok &= eq(run(b'{"streams":[9'*1 + b'0'*5000 + b']}'), INVALID, "huge int -> invalid_json")
ok &= eq(run(b'{"streams":[]}'), {"streams": []}, "zero streams")
ok &= eq(run(b'{"streams":[{"events":[]}]}'), {"error": "invalid_json"}, "missing structure -> invalid_json fallback")

print("json layer:", "OK" if ok else "FAILED")
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
EOF
cd /workspace/tmp && python3 tests/targeted.py
